Definition: from a derivative of G138; to make a choice:--choose.
BiblicalUsage: The word hairetízō carries the sense of to choose, chosen. In Matthew 12:18, the text says "whom I have chosen."
TheologicalSignificance: I read hairetízō plainly — it means to choose, chosen, and I do not build a doctrine on it.
